t.BUTYROSPERMUM_PARKII_BUTTER.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.BUTYROSPERMUM_PARKII_BUTTER.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.BUTYROSPERMUM_PARKII_BUTTER.summary: A solid plant fat obtained from the kernels of the shea tree.
t.BUTYROSPERMUM_PARKII_BUTTER.what: Softens the skin and thickens the product.
